summary.text: Natalie Manley is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 98, in office since 2013, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A certified public accountant, she chairs the Health Care Availability & Accessibility Committee.

paragraphs.text: Natalie Manley earned an A.A. from Joliet Junior College and a B.A. in business administration from the University of Saint Francis.
Her professional experience includes working as a certified public accountant.
Manley assumed office in the Illinois House in 2013 and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Health Care Availability & Accessibility Committee, vice-chair of the House Financial Institutions Committee, and a member of the Counties & Townships, Ethics & Elections, Health Care Licenses, and International Relations, Tourism, and Trade committees and the Legislative Audit Commission.
Ballotpedia lists Nona Parker (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
